location_description: The tension-clamp aluminum tube is located within the blue box. Its left end is connected to the conductor, and its right end is connected to the steel anchor.
left_end_crimp: Yes | The left, conductor end remains smooth and cylindrical, with no continuous angular crimping marks or locally flattened section.
right_end_crimp: Yes | The right, steel-anchor end also remains smooth and cylindrical, with no angular section formed by crimping or any sign of plastic deformation on the steel-anchor side.
grade_result: Kind | Both ends of the aluminum tube are smooth, even, and cylindrical, with no angular crimping marks. Neither the conductor side nor the steel-anchor side contains a regularly flattened or angular section. False crimping features caused by illumination or corrosion spots have been excluded. This is an uncrimped-uncrimped condition and is therefore graded as Kind according to the decision tree.
